title: Let's build a Chatbot - Image Generation (Part 7)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to part 7 of the Let's Build a Chatbot in C Sharp using Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到使用 C# 與 Agent Framework 打造聊天機器人的第七部分。

cues.en: We're still in Blazor's server, and before we go on to having other backends and frontends, I want to add a little more features so we feel like the baseline is more feature complete.
cues.zh: 目前仍使用 Blazor Server。在加入其他前後端之前，想先增加一些功能，讓基本版更完整。

cues.en: And that is, in this case, image generation.
cues.zh: 這次要加入圖像生成。

cues.en: We want to be able to generate images on top of being able to just talk with a chatbot, just like we can do in ChatGPT.
cues.zh: 除了與聊天機器人對話，也希望像 ChatGPT 一樣，可以生成圖片。

cues.en: So before we jump into the code, let me quickly show it to you.
cues.zh: 看程式碼前，先快速示範。

cues.en: So we can just say hi, like we normally do.
cues.zh: 可以像平常一樣說你好。

cues.en: I will move this breakpoint while we wait, and then we'll go into it.
cues.zh: 等待時，先移除這個中斷點，稍後再介紹。

cues.en: And that just answer back like normal, what a ChatGPT will also do.
cues.zh: 它就和平常、也和 ChatGPT 一樣回覆。

cues.en: But the second, we begin to ask something about generating images.
cues.zh: 但當我們開始要求生成圖片，

cues.en: Generate an image of a cute dog.
cues.zh: 例如：產生一張可愛狗狗的圖片。

cues.en: It now says generating images here.
cues.zh: 這裡就會顯示正在生成圖片。

cues.en: And while it does that, generating images takes quite a while.
cues.zh: 圖像生成需要比較長的時間。

cues.en: So at some point in this video, I also mentioned that I stopped the recording and restarted again, so you don't need to sit and wait for these images.
cues.zh: 所以影片中有時會暫停錄影，再於完成後繼續，免得你一直等。

cues.en: But while we wait for the image, there's two ways of doing images.
cues.zh: 等待時先說明，圖像功能有兩種實作方式。

cues.en: This is the way that ChatGPT does it, but it's kind of limiting, because this is a general mode we go into right now.
cues.zh: 這是 ChatGPT 類似的做法，但有一些限制，因為現在會進入獨立的生成模式。

cues.en: And we're using a small agent up front to figure out if we want to go into image generation mode, or we want to actually just let our chatbot
cues.zh: 我們先用一個小型代理程式判斷，應該切換到圖像生成模式，還是讓聊天機器人，

cues.en: have a tool that can generate images.
cues.zh: 擁有一個可以生成圖片的工具。

cues.en: So I built in an option where we can switch between these two, and we're going to go through the router agent first, because it's probably the one you would do,
cues.zh: 因此加入選項，可以切換兩種方式。先介紹路由代理程式，因為這可能是你會採用的做法，

cues.en: but the other one has some neat features as well, and actually also a bug I found in the agent frame that I need to create.
cues.zh: 另一種也有不錯的特性，不過我發現了一個 Agent Framework 錯誤，需要回報。

cues.en: But we got a cute dog. That's nice.
cues.zh: 我們取得可愛的狗狗圖片了，很好。

cues.en: So let's see how this is done behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 接著看看背後如何實作。

cues.en: And the best way to do that is if we go in and set a breakpoint in our SendAsync.
cues.zh: 最好的觀察方式，是在 SendAsync 設中斷點。

cues.en: And then we go in and say, generate an image of cozy house on a hill.
cues.zh: 接著要求：產生一張山丘上溫馨房屋的圖片。

cues.en: So we get our input. That's okay.
cues.zh: 取得輸入，沒有問題。

cues.en: We get our setup of the missing title.
cues.zh: 接著處理尚未建立的標題。

cues.en: I've moved this up a bit so it happens before we figure out if we want to go into one of the other modes, because no matter what, we need to generate a title, so that's okay.
cues.zh: 我把這段移到較前面，在判斷模式之前處理，因為無論哪種模式，都需要標題。

cues.en: And we put the message into the GUI so we can see it.
cues.zh: 再把訊息放到介面中，方便查看。

cues.en: And then I'm taking the image gen style here, and right now we are hitting the router agent.
cues.zh: 接著檢查 ImageGenStyle，目前使用路由代理程式。

cues.en: So we are essentially making one more agent.
cues.zh: 因此實際上又建立一個代理程式。

cues.en: One for title, one for agent, and one for chatbot.
cues.zh: 一個產生標題、一個路由，還有一個聊天機器人。

cues.en: But here we are just making a small GPT-5 mini and asking it, it should determine if we are in image mode or if we are in chatbot mode, meaning if we say hi,
cues.zh: 這裡使用小型 GPT-5 mini，要求判斷應該進入圖像模式，還是聊天模式。例如說你好，

cues.en: we should be in chatbot mode.
cues.zh: 就應該進入聊天模式。

cues.en: If we have an image, generate image of something, we should be in image generation mode.
cues.zh: 如果要求生成某張圖片，就應該進入圖像生成模式。

cues.en: And we do that using just a normal structured output of something I call task type, where we have the two different routes that are called here.
cues.zh: 透過一般結構化輸出完成，型別叫 TaskType，包含這兩個不同路由。

cues.en: And in this case, since we said generate image of... what was it?
cues.zh: 這個例子要求生成……剛剛是什麼？

cues.en: For cozy house on a hill, we can see that we end up in the task where it's generate image.
cues.zh: 山丘上的溫馨房屋，因此可以看到選擇了 GenerateImage。

cues.en: And then the other one, I've just extracted the normal content from previous videos in here, where we do the agent and do the streaming or non-streaming.
cues.zh: 另一個路由只是把前面影片的一般聊天程式碼抽出來，建立代理程式，再使用串流或非串流。

cues.en: But in this case, we're not even gonna do any chatbottles...
cues.zh: 但這個情況不會顯示任何聊天，

cues.en: bubbles back or anything, we're just doing the images.
cues.zh: 回應泡泡，只處理圖片。

cues.en: And the way we do that is we first have a new Boolean to keep track of if we are in image generation mode right now.
cues.zh: 先加入一個新的布林值，記錄目前是否正在生成圖片。

cues.en: So that means now we can't see it, but it will say generate image as you saw before.
cues.zh: 所以現在雖然看不到，但它會像前面一樣顯示正在生成圖片。

cues.en: And in here, it will now show us that we need to do a prompt, but image generation doesn't do a prompt in that it can take
cues.zh: 接著需要建立提示詞。不過圖像生成不能像一般對話一樣，直接接收，

cues.en: multiple chat messages in from user assistance and so on.
cues.zh: 多則 user、assistant 訊息。

cues.en: So I'm actually building that up on the fly here using just a small for each loop.
cues.zh: 因此用一個小型 foreach，把內容即時組合起來。

cues.en: Because I want to give the full context, so we can, in this case, just one message.
cues.zh: 因為想提供完整上下文，這個例子目前只有一則訊息。

cues.en: But if I later said, no, make it summertime or make it wintertime, and then it will be able to understand and still generate an image,
cues.zh: 但如果之後說「不，改成夏天」或「改成冬天」，它就能理解，仍然生成圖片，

cues.en: but just with a different tweak to the image generation.
cues.zh: 只是依新要求調整。

cues.en: Here I have a small image generation tool.
cues.zh: 這裡有一個小型圖像生成工具。

cues.en: I put it out as a tool here itself where we call it manually here.
cues.zh: 我把它獨立成工具，這裡先手動呼叫。

cues.en: But later on, we'll see that the agent itself can also call this tool.
cues.zh: 稍後會看到，代理程式自己也可以呼叫這個工具。

cues.en: And we're giving in the prompt.
cues.zh: 先傳入提示詞。

cues.en: So we have our prompt.
cues.zh: 這就是目前的提示詞。

cues.en: And with our agent factory that we normally make the agents from, we can get the connection and the raw client.
cues.zh: 透過平常建立代理程式的 Agent Factory，可以取得連線與原生用戶端。

cues.en: So we can get the Azure OpenAI client here because agent framework itself can't do anything with images.
cues.zh: 因此這裡取得 AzureOpenAIClient，因為 Agent Framework 本身不能直接生成圖片。

cues.en: We need to use the raw image client from OpenAI or Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 需要使用 OpenAI 或 Azure OpenAI 的原生 ImageClient。

cues.en: And then we're just saying generate image async.
cues.zh: 接著呼叫 GenerateImageAsync。

cues.en: There is various other options you can set on generate image, but we have covered that in other videos.
cues.zh: 圖像生成還有其他選項，不過其他影片已經介紹。

cues.en: But we're just saying make this house.
cues.zh: 這裡只要求生成這間房子。

cues.en: So it will do work on that right now.
cues.zh: 目前正在處理。

cues.en: And I will pause the video until it comes back.
cues.zh: 我先暫停影片，等完成再回來。

cues.en: And we're back. It took 52 seconds in order to do it.
cues.zh: 回來了，這次花了 52 秒。

cues.en: But we now have our image in this as a binary PNG.
cues.zh: 現在取得的是二進位 PNG 圖片。

cues.en: And what we do with that PNG, because we need to show it in a browser, we put it in the VVV route of the Blazor.
cues.zh: 為了在瀏覽器顯示，把 PNG 放進 Blazor 的 wwwroot。

cues.en: So we generate that folder, and we just generate a random PNG file name with a GUID.
cues.zh: 先建立資料夾，再用 GUID 產生隨機 PNG 檔名。

cues.en: Then we take our stream of our image byte and essentially make the file.
cues.zh: 接著把圖片位元組串流寫入檔案。

cues.en: So we do that, and then we add to our conversation a new message saying that we have a message that is just called image part,
cues.zh: 完成後，在對話加入新的訊息，包含我稱為 ImagePart 的欄位，

cues.en: because these images are not really stored anywhere in our normal conversation.
cues.zh: 因為原本一般對話格式裡，並沒有這些生成圖片的儲存位置。

cues.en: But because we have a custom conversation where we previously put in the usage, we can now also just put an image part in.
cues.zh: 但我們使用自訂 Conversation，前面已經能加入 Usage，現在也能加入 ImagePart。

cues.en: So that was nice doing that instead of the 18 sessions.
cues.zh: 所以沒有使用 Agent Session，這時就很方便。

cues.en: So we do that, and we just say image generated, which we don't use here.
cues.zh: 完成後回傳 Image Generated，不過這裡沒有使用那段文字。

cues.en: And we are essentially done.
cues.zh: 基本上就完成了。

cues.en: And we can go back and see that we got a cozy house on a hill.
cues.zh: 回到畫面，可以看到山丘上的溫馨房屋。

cues.en: And now we could do follow-up prompts.
cues.zh: 現在還可以追問。

cues.en: Make it winter time.
cues.zh: 改成冬天。

cues.en: Run it again exactly the same.
cues.zh: 再次執行相同流程。

cues.en: Let's generate an image. I will pause, and I will let you see the result.
cues.zh: 開始生成圖片。我先暫停，完成後給你看結果。

cues.en: And we're back. We got a winter house instead.
cues.zh: 回來了，現在變成冬天的房屋。

cues.en: So again, follow-up prompts can be seen because we give the entire context as a generate route.
cues.zh: 因此只要提供完整上下文，就能理解後續要求。

cues.en: So this is how ChatGBT roughly do it, but I kind of feel that it has a little...
cues.zh: ChatGPT 大致採用這種流程，但我覺得它有一點，

cues.en: Yeah, limitation, because we also in this chatbot have a tool called Get Weather.
cues.zh: 限制。因為這個聊天機器人也有 GetWeather 工具。

cues.en: So what if I wanted to say generate an image of how the weather is in Paris?
cues.zh: 如果想說：依照巴黎現在的天氣，生成一張圖片呢？

cues.en: That would not work because it would either go into image mode and not be able to call the tool, or it would go into the tool mode,
cues.zh: 這樣無法直接運作，因為要嘛進入圖像模式，不能呼叫天氣工具；要嘛進入工具，

cues.en: or the chatbot mode, call the tool, but don't have any access to images.
cues.zh: 也就是聊天模式，呼叫工具，但不能生成圖片。

cues.en: So for that reason, I have put in that we can do it in a different way.
cues.zh: 因此我加入另一種做法。

cues.en: So we can go in and use ImageGen as tool.
cues.zh: 可以選擇把 ImageGen 當成工具。

cues.en: And code-wise, the only thing that is really different is that now we go into this one, where we just use the chatbot like normal.
cues.zh: 程式碼最大的差異，只是現在走這個分支，像平常一樣使用聊天機器人。

cues.en: So now we're not having an upfront agent.
cues.zh: 不再有預先執行的路由代理程式。

cues.en: That is kind of good because it takes up time.
cues.zh: 這有好處，因為路由判斷也需要時間。

cues.en: But when we do this, if you look at ChatGBT whenever it's create images and you say create image,
cues.zh: 不過看看 ChatGPT，要求生成圖片時，

cues.en: it would normally just create the image for you and nothing more.
cues.zh: 通常只生成圖片，不附加其他內容。

cues.en: If we do it like this, it will always both create the image because that's the result of the tool, but it will also come back with a message saying,
cues.zh: 若採用工具方式，除了生成工具結果中的圖片，還會回傳訊息說，

cues.en: I've created the image, blah, blah, blah.
cues.zh: 我已經生成圖片等等。

cues.en: So that's the drawback of doing it this way, and apparently OpenAI likes the other way best, but let's just see how it's done.
cues.zh: 這就是這種做法的缺點。顯然 OpenAI 偏好另一種方式，不過先看看如何實作。

cues.en: So the only thing we need to do is we just need to new up a tool.
cues.zh: 只需要建立一個工具物件。

cues.en: And we need to new it up every single time because we want to give the entire conversation.
cues.zh: 而且每次都要重新建立，因為要傳入目前完整對話。

cues.en: So when we do the tool, we can add the extra message in.
cues.zh: 這樣工具執行時，就能把額外訊息加入對話。

cues.en: We could also have begun to work with the agent and doing middleware and doing it before and after the call itself, but this is just the easier way.
cues.zh: 也可以改用代理程式中介軟體，在呼叫前後處理，但目前這樣比較簡單。

cues.en: But as we have seen this code already, it's just the same code, now just being prompted by the LLM.
cues.zh: 這段程式碼剛剛已經看過，完全相同，只是改由 LLM 提供提示詞並呼叫。

cues.en: So we can go in and do the normal things,
cues.zh: 現在可以正常操作，

cues.en: so we can just say create an image
cues.zh: 例如說：產生一張圖片，

cues.en: of an apple.
cues.zh: 內容是一顆蘋果。

cues.en: So now it will do a tool call with a create image, and you can see it turns it out based on this
cues.zh: 它會呼叫 CreateImage 工具，可以看到它根據要求，

cues.en: to choose itself what the prompt should be.
cues.zh: 自行選擇合適的提示詞。

cues.en: That could also be some value of it if you have some instructions on always being
cues.zh: 如果設定了指示，例如一律採用，

cues.en: photorealistic, cartoon, or something like that.
cues.zh: 寫實攝影、卡通等風格，這也可能是優點。

cues.en: But it can also send it off in a different direction based on what you wrote.
cues.zh: 但它也可能根據你的文字，把圖片引導到另一個方向。

cues.en: But now it's doing a tool call, doing exactly the same thing.
cues.zh: 現在是工具呼叫，但執行相同的圖像生成。

cues.en: I will again pause. No, it's actually finished, so that's good.
cues.zh: 我再暫停一下。喔，其實已經好了，很好。

cues.en: So it came back, but you can see we get this back as well, which is kind of good, kind of annoying,
cues.zh: 結果回來了，但也會多這段文字。這可能很好，也可能很惱人，

cues.en: depending on what you like in the way.
cues.zh: 取決於你偏好的互動方式。

cues.en: Apparently OpenAI didn't like this, so they didn't implement it this way.
cues.zh: 顯然 OpenAI 不喜歡這樣，所以沒有用這種方式實作。

cues.en: We could again go in and say from the old videos, what is the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 同樣可以先問：巴黎的天氣如何？

cues.en: Now we're not doing images because it has nothing to do with images, so it calls the weather.
cues.zh: 這次與圖片無關，因此只會呼叫天氣工具。

cues.en: And we'll just go back with that.
cues.zh: 接著取得回覆。

cues.en: But then we can, of course, go in and say generate an image of Paris
cues.zh: 然後當然可以說：生成一張巴黎的圖片，

cues.en: in that weather.
cues.zh: 使用剛剛那種天氣。

cues.en: And had the weather been rain, it should make an image of Paris in rain.
cues.zh: 如果剛剛是下雨，就應該生成雨中的巴黎。

cues.en: But now we can see it says it needs to be in a very hot weather, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 但現在可以看到，提示詞寫的是非常炎熱的天氣等內容。

cues.en: So that is good, of course, that we can just get the entire prompt.
cues.zh: 這當然很好，因為可以取得完整提示詞。

cues.en: And while we wait for this, I wanted to make it so I could say
cues.zh: 等待時，原本我還想讓使用者直接說，

cues.en: the following prompt.
cues.zh: 下面這個提示詞。

cues.en: We'll send it a little while.
cues.zh: 稍等一下再送出。

cues.en: Generate an image of how the weather is in Paris right now.
cues.zh: 生成一張符合巴黎目前天氣的圖片。

cues.en: And it sort of works, and then it totally breaks down.
cues.zh: 它某種程度上可以運作，但之後就完全出錯。

cues.en: And we'll see why in one second.
cues.zh: 稍後會看到原因。

cues.en: But I will pause the video for the image.
cues.zh: 我先暫停，等待圖片完成。

cues.en: Oh, there it is.
cues.zh: 喔，出來了。

cues.en: So it showed an image. It's sunny.
cues.zh: 圖片顯示晴天，

cues.en: It has the hot glow and so on.
cues.zh: 有炎熱的陽光等效果。

cues.en: That makes total sense that it did that.
cues.zh: 這完全符合前面的天氣資訊。

cues.en: And had we had some other weather, it would have given something else.
cues.zh: 如果是其他天氣，圖片也應該會不同。

cues.en: But let's see what happens when I give this prompt, where we actually try and change the two tools, the weather tool and the image tool.
cues.zh: 但接著看看，當這個提示詞要求串接天氣與圖像兩個工具時，會發生什麼。

cues.en: Because when we send it, it looks like it's actually doing it quite all right.
cues.zh: 送出後，看起來處理得相當正常。

cues.en: So it's calling the weather.
cues.zh: 先呼叫天氣工具。

cues.en: It's figuring out that it's hot. It still is.
cues.zh: 確認目前很熱，現在仍然如此。

cues.en: And then, based on that, it makes a second tool call.
cues.zh: 接著根據結果，執行第二次工具呼叫。

cues.en: But I have had problems that it seems like it messes up either in the LLM or in Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 但我遇到的問題是，LLM 或 Agent Framework 似乎會把某些資料弄亂。

cues.en: I need to make a bug report for this after this video.
cues.zh: 影片完成後，需要提交錯誤報告。

cues.en: But I just wanted to show it. It might work when you see this video.
cues.zh: 只是先示範給你看，你看到影片時，也許已經修好了。

cues.en: Or it might be a limitation and perhaps be why chat.gpt has not implemented it this way.
cues.zh: 也可能是一項限制，甚至是 ChatGPT 沒用這種方式實作的原因。

cues.en: And it might also have gone away now.
cues.zh: 或者現在又剛好能正常運作。

cues.en: These services can be a bit temperamental, of course.
cues.zh: 這些服務有時確實有點不穩定。

cues.en: Let's see what happens.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: So the tool is definitely being called.
cues.zh: 工具確實有被呼叫。

cues.en: And I know it's generating the image right now.
cues.zh: 我也知道，目前正在生成圖片。

cues.en: And it will actually also show the image.
cues.zh: 而且圖片實際上也會顯示出來。

cues.en: And then we get this.
cues.zh: 接著就會出現這個錯誤。

cues.en: We get an invalid request error.
cues.zh: Invalid Request，也就是無效請求。

cues.en: No tool called found for function call output with call ID and then the latest call ID.
cues.zh: 訊息說找不到符合 Function Call Output 與指定 CallId 的工具呼叫，後面是最新的呼叫 ID。

cues.en: I tried this both with streaming, non-streaming.
cues.zh: 我試過串流與非串流，

cues.en: I've tried it with a bigger model.
cues.zh: 也試過更大的模型。

cues.en: But it seems like something goes wrong for some reason.
cues.zh: 但不知為何，似乎仍會出錯。

cues.en: Perhaps because we make a different kind of call to a different kind of service.
cues.zh: 也許是因為我們對不同類型的服務，發出了不同類型的呼叫。

cues.en: It might be a bug.
cues.zh: 可能是一個錯誤。

cues.en: Because if we go in and begin to look at these updates behind the scenes and find the tools and stuff, the tools are there.
cues.zh: 因為如果查看背後的 Update，工具等內容確實都存在。

cues.en: But they just say it doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 但系統卻說找不到。

cues.en: And there is some internal guards in Agent Framework.
cues.zh: Agent Framework 內部有一些防護檢查。

cues.en: So I think it will be Agent Framework problem here that something is being checked in an incorrect manner
cues.zh: 所以我懷疑問題在 Agent Framework，某個檢查條件不正確，

cues.en: where they always want to have a tool request and a tool response.
cues.zh: 它要求工具要求與工具回應必須對應。

cues.en: Tool request and tool response.
cues.zh: 也就是每個要求都要配上回應。

cues.en: And this error message is essentially saying that no tool found for function call output with call ID.
cues.zh: 這個錯誤訊息基本上就是：找不到對應 CallId 的工具呼叫，但收到了函式輸出。

cues.en: So it says it has an output, but it couldn't find the request itself.
cues.zh: 所以它有輸出，卻找不到原本的要求。

cues.en: Again, I will log it.
cues.zh: 同樣地，我會提交錯誤報告。

cues.en: But just be aware that that might be a problem if you're doing this just after the video has been done.
cues.zh: 只要注意，如果在影片剛發布時照做，可能遇到這個問題。

cues.en: Because behind the scenes, we can see it actually made it, showed everything, and so on.
cues.zh: 因為背後確實完成了生成，圖片也顯示了。

cues.en: But then it's just the final message back from the agent that fails because the guards inside Agent Framework fails with that.
cues.zh: 只是最後代理程式回覆時，Agent Framework 內部檢查失敗。

cues.en: But beyond that...
cues.zh: 除此之外……

cues.en: Let me get rid of the exception...
cues.zh: 先把例外狀態清掉，

cues.en: And reload here.
cues.zh: 再重新載入。

cues.en: But beyond that, we can now see that there's nothing much to it.
cues.zh: 除此之外，可以看到，實作其實沒有太多內容。

cues.en: We make a tool that we have down here.
cues.zh: 建立下面這個工具，

cues.en: And that tool can either be called using as a normal tool.
cues.zh: 可以把它當成一般工具使用。

cues.en: Then it's just LM choosing when to make images, when to do not.
cues.zh: 這樣由 LLM 決定何時生成圖片、何時不生成。

cues.en: As long as we don't do multi-tools at the same time, it seems to work.
cues.zh: 只要不是同一輪串接多個工具，目前看起來就能正常運作。

cues.en: All we can do as ChatGBG chose is that we can put up an agent up front that checks are we in image generation mode
cues.zh: 或者像 ChatGPT 選擇的方式，在前面放一個代理程式，判斷目前是圖像生成模式，

cues.en: or are we in chat mode at the moment.
cues.zh: 還是聊天模式。

cues.en: That is actually everything for this video.
cues.zh: 這支影片的內容就是這些。

cues.zh: 下次會繼續為 Blazor Server 加入一些功能，再繼續往後。

cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
